subject: SIG evidence request: attestation for code review provenance and ephemeral secrets
messages:
From: Evan Shaw <evan.shaw@redbank.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG evidence request: code review proof and secrets handling

Hi Kimberly,

We are progressing through our SIG assessment and the assessor asked for concrete artifacts demonstrating your secure SDLC controls focused on code review provenance, CI gating, and ephemeral secrets handling. Specifically they want:
- A short attestation describing how code review provenance is tracked (PR metadata, signed commits, reviewer match rules)
- CI gate logs or summaries showing build/test gating and merge enforcement for the last 90 days
- Evidence that credentials used in CI are ephemeral or vaulted, with rotation cadence and an example of a revoked credential and rotation event

Can you turn around an evidence package by next Wednesday 3/7? If there are any constraints on sharing logs, let me know and I can raise with the assessor.

Thanks,
Evan
SOC lead, RedBank
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Shaw <evan.shaw@redbank.com>
Date: 2028-03-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request: code review proof and secrets handling

Evan,

Thanks for the clear ask. We can provide a concise package that includes an attestation letter, PR provenance extracts, CI gating summaries, and a secrets rotation sample. I need to coordinate a few items internally for the logs that contain limited customer data.

I will send a preliminary package and a short attestation by Friday 3/3 and the full log excerpts plus rotation sample by Wednesday 3/7.

Sharing plan: we will post artifacts to a shared Drive folder and deliver a signed attestation PDF; any sensitive logs will be redacted and noted in the attestation.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: 2028-03-01T10:23:00-07:00
Subject: FW: SIG evidence request: code review proof and secrets handling

Team,

Evan at RedBank needs a SIG/sdlc evidence package. Scope: code review provenance, CI gating logs, ephemeral secrets rotation and a revoked credential example. Deadline for full package 3/7.

What I need from each of you:
- Rishi: short attestation text describing our signed commit and PR metadata approach, and a pointer to the commit-signing pipeline (where keys are stored, signing enforcement).
- Monica: export of CI gating summaries for the last 90 days for main and release branches (redact PII but keep event timestamps and pipeline status). If gating logs are large, provide a 2-page excerpt and a pointer to the secure archive.
- Jordan: confirmed example of an ephemeral credential rotation event from Vault/HSM, including a record showing revocation and the subsequent job re-run that picked up the rotated secret. Supply a hashed id if the raw secret cannot be shared.

Attachments to include in final package: attestation PDF, logs excerpt, rotation summary CSV, and a short README describing redactions.

Thanks,
Kimberly
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-02T14:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: SIG evidence request: code review proof and secrets handling

Kimberly, Monica,

Draft for attestation text below, use this as a starting point for the PDF: 

Redwood Inference attests that code review provenance is enforced across our Git workflow via mandatory pull request reviews, signed commits, and branch protection rules. All pull requests targeting main and release branches require at least one approver from a different owner team and must pass the CI gating pipeline before merge. Commit signing is enforced for automated release branches; developer commits are encouraged to be GPG-signed and are captured in commit metadata stored in our audit logs. PR metadata is retained for 1 year in the audit index.

I will also attach a short script output showing PR metadata fields we include (author, reviewer, approval timestamp, merge commit id).

Rishi
Senior Engineer, Platform
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-04T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: SIG evidence request: code review proof and secrets handling

Kimberly, Rishi,

Attached are the excerpts you asked for. I prepared: 
- ci_pipeline_gating_log_excerpt.txt  (build/test/pass/fail timestamps for main and release branches, last 90 days)
- ephemeral-secrets-rotation-summary.csv (rotation events, role, rotation timestamp, requestor id hashed)
- sdlc_attestation_index.pdf (draft attestation with redaction notes)

Notes on redaction: logs exclude file-level diffs and any customer data; requestor ids in the rotation CSV are hashed to avoid exposing usernames. Full archives live in the secure audit bucket; link included in README inside Drive.

If you want me to swap the hashed ids for hashed+salted for the assessor, say the word and I will generate a salted export.

- Monica
Engineering Manager, Build Systems
[Attachment: ci_pipeline_gating_log_excerpt.txt (text)]
[Attachment: ephemeral-secrets-rotation-summary.csv (csv)]
[Attachment: sdlc_attestation_index.pdf (pdf)]
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Shaw <evan.shaw@redbank.com>, SOC Team <soc@finsecure.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-05T15:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request: code review proof and secrets handling

Evan, SOC team,

Attached is our submission for the SIG SDLC evidence request. Package contents: 
1) sdlc_attestation_index.pdf - signed attestation describing code review provenance, branch protection, commit signing policy, CI gating enforcement, and secrets handling policy
2) ci_pipeline_gating_log_excerpt.txt - 90 day gating excerpt with timestamps and pipeline status; redactions documented in the README
3) ephemeral-secrets-rotation-summary.csv - rotation events and a sample revoked credential event with follow-up re-run trace (requestor id hashed)

Shared Drive location: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSDLC-REDWOOD-RED_BANK
DocuSign attestation: https://docusign.net/embeddedSigning/12345-SIG-ATTEST

If the assessor needs additional context, we can provide a one-hour walkthrough of the logs and the Vault rotation flow next week. Please confirm receipt and whether redbank needs any additional redaction.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Director, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: sdlc_attestation_index.pdf, ci_pipeline_gating_log_excerpt.txt, ephemeral-secrets-rotation-summary.csv]
